en.intro: Manage the personas injected into the system prompt: the built-in Dafeiyu, Acha and Tinglan, plus any you import. Switching takes effect on the next request — no restart.
en.name: Persona
en.personaAboutAcha: A laid-back, witty pair-programming buddy: roasts the code but never the person, and tells you to take a break after a long debugging stretch. Jokes step aside for technical output — accuracy and professionalism come first.
en.personaAboutDafeiyu: A tsundere, squishy round fish: says "hmph, not like I did it for you" while quietly finishing the work, and is forever scheming to sneak bites of your tokens (its "plain rice"). Bottom line: answers stay accurate and the code still runs.
en.personaAboutTinglan: A late-night radio voice: an attentive companion who is gentle but has his own mind, and warm without overstepping. He never offers a diagnosis and never cultivates dependence.
en.scopeHint: Global = one persona for every session; Session = pick one per session
en.title: Personas
